query: SELECT u.id, u.email, u.name, po.processId, p.name as processName FROM users u LEFT JOIN processOwners po ON u.id = po.userId LEFT JOIN processes p ON po.processId = p.id WHERE u.email = 'lalitera@yahoo.com'
